plan.title: migrate:xbrief: clean up ambiguous empty vbrief/xbrief roots

narratives.Description: Make `migrate:xbrief` converge the project layout cleanly instead of leaving ambiguous empty `vbrief/` and `xbrief/` lifecycle roots after a migration. A successful migration removes a fully-migrated empty `vbrief/` or replaces it with an explicit deprecation marker so it never looks like an active source of truth, the doctor signpost reports an unambiguous single-root state, and the cleanup is idempotent across reruns.
narratives.Overview:
Part of epic #2203. Absorbs #2202.

## Summary

Make `migrate:xbrief` converge project layout cleanly instead of leaving ambiguous empty `vbrief/` and `xbrief/` roots.

## Behavior

- Successful `migrate:xbrief` leaves an unambiguous layout: if `vbrief/` is fully migrated and empty, remove it or replace it with an explicit deprecation marker per the compatibility contract.
- If `vbrief/` remains for read-compatibility, it must not look like an active source-of-truth folder.
- `doctor` (#child D) reports `xbrief active` and either `vbrief legacy marker` or `vbrief removed` — never an ambiguous dual layout.
- Idempotent cleanup.

## Acceptance criteria

- Successful `migrate:xbrief` does not leave two indistinguishable empty lifecycle roots.
- Doctor reports an unambiguous state.
- Cleanup is idempotent.
- Tests cover empty legacy folder, non-empty legacy folder, already-migrated layout, and rerun behavior.

## Related

Absorbs #2202. Related #2034, #2110. Parent #2203.
narratives.UserStory: As a Directive consumer migrating from the legacy vbrief layout, I want `migrate:xbrief` to converge to a single unambiguous lifecycle root by removing or explicitly deprecation-marking a fully-migrated empty vbrief tree, so that I am never left with two indistinguishable empty roots and the doctor signpost reports one clear xbrief-active state.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. In `packages/core/src/xbrief-migrate/detect.ts`, extend detection to recognize the ambiguous dual-empty-root state (a `vbrief/` that is fully migrated and empty alongside the canonical `xbrief/`), returning a discriminated result the orchestrator can act on.
2. In `packages/core/src/xbrief-migrate/migrate-project.ts`, after a successful migration replace the unconditional `rmSync(legacyDir)` with a converge step: remove a fully-empty migrated `vbrief/`, or write an explicit deprecation marker (per the compatibility contract in `constants.ts`) when it must remain for read-compat so it never looks like an active source of truth; make the whole cleanup idempotent (rerun is a no-op). Use `fs-helpers.ts` for empty-dir checks and add the marker constant to `constants.ts`.
3. Update `packages/core/src/xbrief-migrate/signpost.ts::renderXbriefMigrationLine` so the doctor-facing one-liner reports an unambiguous state -- `xbrief active` plus either `vbrief legacy marker` or `vbrief removed`, never a dual-empty-root ambiguity. Export any new helper from `packages/core/src/xbrief-migrate/index.ts`.
4. Keep the CLI wrapper `packages/cli/src/migrate-xbrief.ts` thin (arg passthrough); do NOT edit doctor/main.ts or doctor.ts (the doctor already consumes signpost.ts) or any init/dispatch files.
5. Colocated vitest in `detect.test.ts`, `migrate-project.test.ts`, `signpost.test.ts`, and `migrate-xbrief.test.ts` covering empty-legacy, non-empty-legacy, already-migrated, and rerun/idempotency behavior. Add a brief CHANGELOG entry. Run `task ts:check-lane`, targeted vitest, and `task check:framework-source`.
